note: Coordinate estimates below come from magnified crops (3.4x) of assets/news/layers/8.png; they are coarse on purpose and are not sufficient for unattended pixel work. Origin (0,0) top-left of the 941x1672 canvas.

head.action: manual redraw as head base layer; preserve glasses rim position and hair silhouette

brow_left.action: manual extraction: solid dark stroke shape; thicken for 'unimpressed' state variants

brow_right.action: manual extraction (partially hidden behind glasses bridge)

eye_left.action: manual redraw: half-lidded iris (dark upper arc). Provide neutral/blink/bored/unimpressed variants

eye_right.action: manual redraw: mirror of left eye; glasses rim overlaps upper third

lid_left.action: separate eyelid layer for blink states (line of lid arcs already visible)

lid_right.action: separate eyelid layer for blink states

mouth_frown.action: manual redraw: only a shallow frown line is visible; beard covers remainder

beard.action: full redraw required for mouth animation behind it; keep silhouette identical to master

glasses.action: manual separation into a single 'glasses' asset; rims + bridge + arms as ONE static layer over eyes

hair.action: manual separation or static; do not re-render, do not clean beyond alpha matting

notFeasibleProgrammatically: Eye-rest vs blink vs bored variants (no scalable-vector source; raster pixels are half-litrets of differing line weights)
Mouth shapes behind the beard (the articulation simply does not exist in the flattened art)
Per-portion nose/cheek separation (independent shading painted directly onto the base)

knownLimitations: No editable/vector source exists in the repo — all layers are flattened raster.
Original RGB originals under assets/news/original/ are white-background composites; layers/ have alpha but a thin light fringe halo is visible on 1.png and 2.png edges.
Glasses rim holds most of the eyelid boundary — a clean lid cut must extend ~4px under the rim.
Mouth is mostly hidden by the beard; visemes will read via beard-edge silhouette motion, not lip shapes.
All coordinate estimates are ±6px; any artist pass must re-derive anchors from eye-centre grids.
